attchmntText: Fusion CX Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
voiceSummary: Fusion CX Limited has sent a letter to shareholders providing a web link to the Notice of the 23rd Annual General Meeting and the Annual Report for the Financial Year 2025-26. This communication is directed at members who have not registered their email addresses with the Company or Depositories. The 23rd Annual General Meeting is scheduled for Monday, December 14, 2026, at 05.00 p.m. Indian Standard Time. The meeting will be held through Video Conferencing or Other Audio Visual Means. The documents are available on the Company website at www.fusioncx.com and on the websites of BSE Limited and National Stock Exchange of India Limited. The letter was issued by Company Secretary Barun Singh on November 21, 2026.

attchmntText: Maruti Suzuki India Limited has informed the Exchange about Price increase
voiceSummary: Maruti Suzuki India Limited has increased prices of select models effective 22nd November 2026. The company cites sustained cost pressures as the reason for this decision. The estimated volume weighted average price increase is around 0.31 percent. Management states that despite cost reduction efforts, prevailing pressures necessitate passing a portion of the increase to the market. The goal is to minimize the impact on customers. This notice is filed with the National Stock Exchange and BSE Limited. Sanjeev Grover, Executive Officer and Company Secretary, issued the communication on 22nd November 2026.

attchmntText: Fusion CX Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Notice and Annual Report of Annual General Meeting to be held on December 14, 2026
voiceSummary: Fusion CX Limited has issued a notice for its 23rd Annual General Meeting scheduled for December 14, 2026, at 5:00 P.M. via video conferencing. The meeting will consider the adoption of audited financial statements for the year ended March 31, 2026. A dividend of Rs. 0.75 per equity share is proposed, with a record date of November 27, 2026. Mr. Ritesh Chakraborty, DIN 11015389, will not seek re-election. Price Waterhouse & Co Chartered Accountants LLP is proposed as the new statutory auditor. The appointment of Mr. Andrew Jay Wilmott, DIN 12047388, as a Non-Executive Non-Independent Director is placed for approval. The appointment of Mr. Rakesh Sony, DIN 00363053, as a Non-Executive Independent Director for five years is subject to shareholder approval. Similarly, Mr. Narayanan Subramaniam, DIN 00166621, is proposed as a Non-Executive Independent Director for five years. Pravin Kumar Drolia is proposed as the secretarial auditor for five years. These resolutions are pending shareholder vote.

attchmntText: Moschip Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: MosChip Technologies Limited published a corrigendum to the notice of its Extra-Ordinary General Meeting scheduled for November 25, 2026. The company removed Ms. Madhura Kolkur from the list of proposed allottees for a preferential issue of equity shares. Consequently, the number of equity shares proposed for issuance was reduced from 50,50,686 to 50,38,472 shares at Rs. 222.14 per share. The aggregate value of swap shares decreased from Rs. 1,12,19,59,388 to Rs. 1,11,92,46,170. The number of proposed allottees was revised from 69 to 68. The meeting remains scheduled for Wednesday, November 25, 2026, at 09:00 A.M. via video conferencing. The corrigendum addresses comments received from stock exchanges regarding the explanatory statement.

attchmntText: ABB India Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: ABB India Limited has issued a notice for a postal ballot to seek shareholder approval for the appointment of Mr. N V Sivakumar, DIN 03534101, as an Independent Director. The resolution is proposed as a Special Resolution for a term of three consecutive years effective January 01, 2027. Voting via remote electronic voting commenced at 9.00 a.m. IST on Sunday, November 22, 2026, and ends at 5.00 p.m. IST on Monday, December 21, 2026. The voting results, along with the Scrutinizer’s report, will be announced on or before 5.00 p.m. IST on Wednesday, December 23, 2026. The outcome is pending the final vote and scrutiny.

attchmntText: Interarch Building Solutions Limited has informed the Exchange about Action(s) initiated or orders passed
voiceSummary: Interarch Building Solutions Limited received a Show Cause Notice on November 21, 2026, from the Office of the Assistant Commissioner of Income Tax, Central Circle-7, Delhi. The notice pertains to block assessment proceedings for the period from April 1, 2019, to October 17, 2025. The Department has proposed an aggregate addition of ₹11,45,82,429 to the company's undisclosed income. This proposal relates to expenditure on erectors, job-workers, and subcontractors, citing issues with documentation and alleged cash returns. The company must submit its response by November 27, 2026. The notice is not a final assessment order. The company states it does not anticipate an immediate impact on business operations and intends to contest the proposed additions.

attchmntText: ESDS Software Solution Limited has informed the Exchange about clarification on the news article.
voiceSummary: ESDS Software Solution Limited issued a clarification under Regulation 30 regarding news about its agreement with Sharon AI for the Sydney AI factory. The company states all 8,208 NVIDIA B300 GPUs are installed and in final testing. Handover is expected in mid-December 2026, with billing starting in January 2027. The entire capacity is contracted on a take-or-pay basis. The company's commitment to Sharon AI is approximately US$ 1.26 billion over 60 months, or about US$ 21 million per month. Customers are expected to pay about US$ 30 million per month. This leaves approximately US$ 9 million per month before operating costs and tax. The company estimates profit after tax of approximately US$ 4 to 5 million per month, representing a margin of approximately 14 to 17 percent. A security deposit of US$ 140 million was placed with Sharon AI in May 2026. This deposit was funded by an advance received from customers. The company will disclose further updates when the factory goes live.

attchmntText: Intellect Design Arena Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Allotment of 67763  Shares.
voiceSummary: Intellect Design Arena Limited has allotted 67,763 equity shares of Rs. 5 each to eligible employees on November 21, 2026. This allotment was approved by the Stakeholders Relationship Committee under the Intellect Stock Option Plan 2015, Intellect Stock Option Plan 2016, and Intellect Incentive Plan Scheme 2018. The company's issued and subscribed share capital has increased to Rs. 70,30,18,100, divided into 14,06,03,620 equity shares. The newly issued shares rank pari-passu with existing equity shares. In-principle approvals for these schemes were previously received from the National Stock Exchange of India Limited and BSE Limited in 2016 and 2019. The distinct share numbers range from 14,06,35,858 to 14,07,03,620. The ISIN for the shares is INE306R01017. No lock-in period applies to these shares.

attchmntText: Coforge Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Allotment of 47824  Shares.
voiceSummary: Coforge Limited has allotted 47,824 equity shares under its ESOP 2005 scheme on November 21, 2026. The ESOP Allotment Committee approved this allotment. Consequently, the paid-up share capital of the company has increased to 44,31,10,688 equity shares. Each share has a face value of Rs. 2. The total capital now aggregates to Rs. 88,62,21,376. The company is completing formalities regarding the issue and listing of these shares. Coforge will file necessary documents with the exchanges shortly to seek listing and trading approvals.

attchmntText: Minda Corporation Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet
voiceSummary: Minda Corporation Limited has intimated that its officials will meet investors and analysts on 27th November 2026. The first meeting is scheduled from 10:00 AM to 11:00 AM, organized by ICICI Securities. The second meeting is scheduled from 03:00 PM to 04:30 PM, organized by Jefferies India. Both meetings will be conducted in person as group meetings. The company confirmed that no unpublished price sensitive information will be disclosed during these sessions. Details regarding participation are available on the company website at www.sparkminda.com.

attchmntText: Tech Mahindra Limited has informed the Exchange regarding the Amendment to AOA/MOA of the company.
voiceSummary: Tech Mahindra Limited announces that the Ordinary Resolutions regarding the increase in authorized share capital from Rs. 924.3 crore to Rs. 1,000 crore and the issue of bonus equity shares have been approved by members via postal ballot. attchmntText: GMR AIRPORTS LIMITED has informed the Exchange about Update on Tariff Matter
voiceSummary: GMR Airports Limited intimates that its subsidiary, GMR Visakhapatnam International Airport Limited, will levy aeronautical charges at Vizag International Airport effective December 01, 2026. attchmntText: U. Y. Fincorp Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: U. Y. Fincorp Limited issued a Corrigendum Cum Addendum to the Notice of the Extra-Ordinary General Meeting scheduled for Wednesday, 25th November 2026. The corrigendum was released in response to queries raised by the National Stock Exchange of India Limited and BSE Limited regarding the company's in-principle approval applications for a proposed preferential issue of equity shares. attchmntText: AMD Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates.
voiceSummary: AMD Industries Limited intimates that a fire broke out at its Corporate Office at 18, Pusa Road, Karol Bagh, New Delhi, on 20 November 2026 at approximately 7:10 p.m. The Fire Brigade brought the fire under control. No injuries or loss of life were reported. The Company’s business operations were unaffected and continue as usual.

attchmntText: Dixon Technologies (India) Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Update on Asset Purchase Agreement executed between Dixon Technologies (India) Limited and Vimal Plast (India) Private Limited'.
voiceSummary: Dixon Technologies completed the acquisition of movable assets from Vimal Plast on 21st November 2026. The transaction involves moulds, research and development lab equipment, basket assembly Korean machines, jigs, and fixtures. The total consideration for the assets is up to INR 49,75,00,000. The Asset Purchase Agreement was originally executed on 16th November 2026. This update is filed under Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. The company confirms that all closing formalities have been concluded.

attchmntText: Shivalik Bimetal Controls Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication - Notice of Extra Ordinary General Meeting 01/2026-27
voiceSummary: Shivalik Bimetal Controls Limited submitted newspaper advertisements regarding the notice for its 01/2026-27 Extra Ordinary General Meeting. The meeting is scheduled for Wednesday, December 16, 2026. The notice, including remote e-voting information and the cut-off date, was published on November 21, 2026. The publications appeared in the Hindi edition of Jansatta and the English edition of Financial Express. Kabir Ghumman, Managing Director with DIN 01294801, signed the submission on behalf of the company. This filing is pursuant to Regulation 47 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015.

attchmntText: Viviana Power Tech Limited has informed the Exchange regarding submission of  Draft Letter of Offer for the proposed right issue.
voiceSummary: Viviana Power Tech Limited submitted the Draft Letter of Offer for a proposed Rights Issue to the National Stock Exchange of India Limited on November 21, 2026. The issue aims to raise up to Rs. 15,000 Lakhs. The company has received in-principle approval from the NSE for the listing of the Rights Equity Shares. The Draft Letter of Offer is attached for record. The issue is subject to regulatory approvals and shareholder approval. Specific details regarding the issue price, number of shares, and record date are not disclosed in this submission. The company confirms that neither it nor its promoters are identified as wilful defaulters or fraudulent borrowers. Skyline Financial Services Pvt. Ltd. is appointed as the registrar to the issue.

attchmntText: Raymond Realty Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet
voiceSummary: Raymond Realty Limited intimates that its representatives will participate in the Kotak Midcap Investor Conference 2026 on November 26, 2026. The meeting will be conducted physically in person as a one-on-one or group session. attchmntText: Greaves Cotton Limited has informed the Exchange about Pendency of Litigation(s)/dispute(s) or the outcome impacting the Company
desc: Pendency of Litigation(s)/dispute(s) or the outcome impacting the Company
voiceSummary: Greaves Cotton Limited received an arbitral award dated 20th November, 2026, in its favour against Deev Genset Sales and Services. The Respondents are permanently restrained from representing themselves as authorised dealers or using authorised spare parts for Indian Railways tenders. They are jointly and severally liable to pay ₹ 21.66 crore plus interest at 12% per annum from August 1, 2022, until payment. Additionally, Respondents must pay costs of ₹ 1.17 crore, with interest at 12% per annum accruing if unpaid within three months. The financial impact depends on actual realisation. The Award is subject to remedies available to Respondents under applicable law.
